note: Real-ELF ProgramTest for the canonical Rational Representation V2 lifecycle waist -- ActivateReceipt, ActivateCoordinate, RetireCoordinate, RetireReceipt against the real, canonically-built Token-2022 v11 runtime and the lifecycle RentCredit (blocked.json: 'A real-ELF ProgramTest for this route already exists and passes; it simply does not emit census evidence yet'). Real Claims, Registry, Core and Rent ELFs with the Product Runtime V3 graph and LiabilityBasisV2 aggregate INSTALLED directly. Campaign: programs/dclutch-claims-sbf/program-test/rational-lifecycle (tests/lifecycle.rs). Every submitted transaction goes through a test-only wrapper that CPIs into Claims, so a refusal Claims itself raises propagates the same numeric code to the wrapper's own top-level failure log -- a failed CPI aborts the whole transaction before the wrapper's Rust code regains control, so that repetition is the runtime's own account of the failure depth, not a second refusal.
